articles.title: Earnings week scorecard: beats rewarded selectively as AI-infrastructure names pull back
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Beats were widespread this week, but the market rewarded only some of them. Cisco and Applied Materials both beat and both sold off. CoreWeave, Rocket Lab and Constellation Energy were rewarded. The week reads as a test of "beat versus priced-in" for the AI-infrastructure trade.

articles.title: Cisco earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Cisco Systems Inc (CSCO) beat on every headline number in FQ1 FY2027 (reported Nov 12, 2026) and still fell. The stock is $95.35, down 6.53% (as of Nov 13, 2:51 PM EST), roughly where it traded before the print and 17% lower over a month.
